episodes.synopsis: Yukari Nejima has been in love with Misaki Tazaki since grade school. He finally builds the confidence to confess his feelings, but nothing goes as planned.
episodes.title: First Love

episodes.synopsis: Neji has now been appointed a wife by the government. When he meets his future wife Ririna, he’s surprised by her reaction when he reveals his secret.
episodes.title: A Small Lie

episodes.synopsis: Ririna invites Neji over to her house only to find Misaki already there. It’s apparent that Ririna has other plans for her assigned husband.
episodes.title: Overlooked Love

episodes.synopsis: Love is complicated when you’re inside the Yukari system. Neji and Ririna must navigate the ministry together if they want their lie to come out intact.
episodes.title: The Science of Love

episodes.synopsis: The camping trip seems to be going well until all four them are forced to confront certain truths about their relationship.
episodes.title: Risky Love

episodes.synopsis: Neji and Ririna have been assigned a special lecture, things take an awkward turn when they realize the nature of the lecture.
episodes.title: A Prison to Compel Love

episodes.synopsis: Ririna is confused about her feelings for Neji, especially after the special lecture. Meanwhile, Misaki questions her role in Neji and Ririna’s life.
episodes.title: A Silent Lie

episodes.synopsis: Neji delves deeper into this friendship with Nisaki, and learns Misaki’s true feelings about his relationship with Ririna.
episodes.title: Feelings Without Lies

episodes.synopsis: With the Romeo and Juliet play about to begin, Neji has a heart to heart with Nisaka about his feelings for the girls.
episodes.title: So Bright It Doesn't Seem Real

episodes.synopsis: Shuu tries to shed light on Misaki’s situation to Ririna and Neji, she also reveals more about the notices and its origins.
episodes.title: A Love to Give Everything For

episodes.synopsis: Feelings start to be questioned when the gang ends up at a wedding, and Misaki can’t help but wish for a lie of her own.
episodes.title: I Don’t Care If It’s A Lie

episodes.synopsis: Naji is forced to face his growing feelings for Ririna head on. With so much on the line, what will happen when these emotions finally start clashing?
episodes.title: Love And Lies
